phase: Phase 2: From Static Route Optimization -> Dynamic Self-Healing Fleet
missing_dependencies: scipy (installed in Python 3.13 env but omitted from requirements.txt)

incomplete_modules.issue: Discrete-event stepping does not physically advance trucks edge-by-edge, lacks order lifecycle tracking (ARRIVED, DELIVERED, LATE, FAILED), and lacks gym-compatible reset/step/observe/execute_action interface.
Missing centralized_agent.py, fleet_agent.py, and truck_agent.py. No strict LocalAgentState vs GlobalState separation.
FleetMetrics exists as a Pydantic model but lacks centralized functional calculators (calculate_total_distance, calculate_total_travel_time, calculate_total_fuel, etc.).
Centralized offline failure metrics in flagship experiment used heuristic approximations (e.g. cent_late=28) rather than running step-by-step closed-loop simulation.
Missing baseline json results and route files for C101, R101, and RC101.
Missing automated plotting pipeline for the 7 required visualization figures.

fake_metrics_audit.action: Replace heuristic estimates with actual closed-loop simulation execution for both Centralized and Decentralized agents.

recommended_fixes: Implement centralized metrics library in src/evaluation/metrics.py
Generate and save real baseline metrics for C101, R101, RC101 in results/baseline/
Implement discrete edge-based vehicle movement and order lifecycle transitions in FleetSimulationEnvironment
Build CentralizedAgent, TruckAgent, and FleetAgent with strict information barrier during Internet outage
Integrate DeliveryExchangeEngine and MeshNetwork into closed-loop simulation
Create plotting module generating 7 visualization plots in results/plots/
Add python main.py audit and expand simulate scenarios (normal, traffic_spike, truck_breakdown, network_failure, full_disruption)
Write comprehensive unit test suite for new simulation, agent, and recovery components
